See the formula ↓

How the calculation works

Future average = [Target × (Completed count + Remaining count) − Current average × Completed count] ÷ Remaining count

A worked example

Three assignments average 70%. With two left, an 80% final average requires 80 × 5 − 70 × 3 = 190 percentage-score units across the last two: 190 ÷ 2 = 95%.

Before you use the result

All assignments must carry equal weight, regardless of their raw point totals. Include awarded zeroes in the current average. This model does not drop scores or add extra credit. If assignment weights differ, use the remaining-grade or weighted-grade calculator.

Results display to two decimal places unless stated otherwise. Read our calculation methodology for scope and limitations.

Frequently asked questions

Do assignments need the same point total?

They need the same final weighting. Equal point totals alone are not enough if your instructor assigns different weights.

Does 95% mean both future assignments must score 95%?

No. Their combined equally weighted average must be at least 95%; individual scores can differ.
